notes: Run 2026-11-05, partial. College of Veterinarians of Ontario (cvo.org): only the 'Find a Veterinarian' page opened; it links to a JS register (cvo.ca.thentiacloud.net) that gives no usable list. ovma.com, ovchsc.ca (OVC Health Sciences Centre emergencies page), animalhealthpartners.com, ctvrc.ca, vectoronto.com and hamiltonevc.ca/contact were refused or not reachable (PROVENANCE_REQUIRED / fetch failure) and skipped, so OVC Guelph is NOT included; uoguelph.ca/ovc/care only said hospitals need a referral. Several hospitals therefore rely on referring clinics' pages (noted per entry). Not covered: Windsor (news item about a planned 24-hour ER could not be opened), Kingston, Sudbury, Thunder Bay, Collingwood/Blue Mountains, Niagara Falls, Guelph (Campus Estates Animal Hospital, 519-837-1212, only seen as a referral name), rest of Muskoka. No duty_rota entries: no opened page states who is on duty. Check: 16 checked, 0 fixed, 0 downgraded, 0 removed (independent check 2026-11-05: all 12 emergency_24h entries incl. both poison lines confirmed on their source pages; 4 of 17 others sampled: Burlington VERH, Animal Health Services, Secord, Kingsway; no duty rotas present).
